mobile.doctor.versions.ok.role: Diagnostics check result (CLI, desktop, pasted into support)
mobile.doctor.versions.ok.note: Doctor check sentence for `lop mobile doctor` and the desktop's Copy diagnostics, read by a non-technical user. 'phone service' is the mobile daemon that the phone app talks to; Radient and Local Operator are product names. Placeholders are pre-formatted numbers and stay verbatim.

mobile.doctor.daemon.not_installed.role: Diagnostics check result (CLI, desktop, pasted into support)
mobile.doctor.daemon.not_installed.note: Doctor check sentence for `lop mobile doctor` and the desktop's Copy diagnostics, read by a non-technical user. 'phone service' is the mobile daemon that the phone app talks to; Radient and Local Operator are product names. A problem line states what is wrong, then the fix as a second sentence. Commands in it (lop mobile restart, lop tunnel start, ...) stay verbatim; 'the Providers page' is the desktop app's Providers page (use the desktop UI's own translation of 'Providers'); 'the Tunnels page of the Radient console' keeps 'Tunnels' verbatim (an English-only web page). Never say 'connector', 'parked' or a reason code.
